description: Optional Windows features to disable offline. Payloads are retained by default (DisableFeature without /Remove).

candidates.reason: Legacy XPS viewer; verify presence before disable.
Legacy SMB 1.0 client/server components are insecure and unused by modern game launchers. SMB1Protocol-Deprecation remains protected under neverDisable.
Enterprise Work Folders client unused on a gaming PC.

notes: Exact feature names are resolved from Get-WindowsOptionalFeature inventory before any change.
Do not disable core networking, security, graphics, audio, or gaming infrastructure.
removePayload=false keeps component payloads for easier servicing and restore.
